description: Calls one catalogue resource with a plain GET. A free resource returns its data. A paid one returns the x402 payment requirements (HTTP 402: price, network, asset, payTo) and is NOT paid by this server, which holds no wallet. To buy: pay with your own x402 client, then call again with the signed payload in `payment`. Nothing is charged unless the data is delivered.

pathParams.description: Values for {placeholders} in the resource path, e.g. {"chain":"ethereum"}. Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

payment.description: Optional. The base64 x402 payment payload YOUR client signed for this exact request; forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

query.description: Query-string parameters named in the resource's params.

name: call_endpoint
title: Call a Blockchain IQ x402 endpoint
